notes.title: UPDATE V1.1
notes.notes:
Bugs reported by players have been fixed.
 Instruction system has been completely redone to make it easier to understand in all languages supported by the game.
 Unsupported screen resolutions have been removed.
 German, Korean and Chinese translation errors have been fixed.
 Drag system after falling to the ground has been improved, now the player will hardly die from slipping on the edges of the ground (remember the player's collision limit).
 Pause system has been improved. Pausing will now cause game time to freeze.
